about: One seeded episode per exported policy (weights/<name>.npz), for animation without simulating. Gymnasium 1.4.0; CartPole-v1 tau = 0.02 s per step, Pendulum-v1 dt = 0.05 s.

dqn_cartpole.note: states[t] is the state in which actions[t] was taken; states has length + 1 entries (s_0 .. s_T)

reinforce_cartpole.note: states[t] is the state in which actions[t] was taken; states has length + 1 entries (s_0 .. s_T)

ppo_cartpole.note: states[t] is the state in which actions[t] was taken; states has length + 1 entries (s_0 .. s_T)

random_cartpole.note: states[t] is the state in which actions[t] was taken; states has length + 1 entries (s_0 .. s_T)

sac_pendulum.state_layout: [theta, theta_dot]; theta in radians, 0 = upright, NOT wrapped to [-pi, pi]
sac_pendulum.note: states[t] is the state in which actions[t] (torque, N m, in [-2, 2]) was applied; length + 1 states
